title: Stakeholder Alignment Compact: 60m Playbook & Decision Canvas
overview: One-page compact facilitation kit for a 60-minute customer review focused on decision-making and clear renewal outcomes. Designed for mid-market and strategic accounts where time is scarce and stakeholders need an explicit decision canvas to align on next-step commitments. Use this when customer execs can only commit 60 minutes and the goal is a concrete renewal or staged commitment (pilot -> expansion).
agenda: 0-5min — Kickoff: Purpose, desired outcome for this 60m session (host + customer execs), quick intros (name + role + 1-line success metric)
5-15min — Signals & Impact: crisp 3–4 slides or bullets: key usage trends, cost vs value signals, top customer-impact incidents since last touch
15-25min — Opportunity Snapshot: where product delivered ROI, 2 brief customer stories (ops + product), top metric delta
25-40min — Decision Canvas (guided): workload/feature to prioritize, success metric, effort/cost, risks, alternatives — facilitator walks canvas live
40-50min — Renewal Ask & Options: present 2 renewal paths (baseline, accelerated), recommended path, near-term milestones and required support
50-60min — Commitments & Close: confirm owners for next steps, immediate blockers, follow-up cadence, record explicit decision and date for contract action
facilitation_script: Kickoff (host): 'Thanks everyone — our aim in 60 minutes is to decide whether we proceed with Option A or Option B and what support is needed. If we get to a different decision, that's okay; we'll capture actions.'
Signals & Impact (host): 'Here are three signals we think matter. I will state the metric, trend, and customer impact. Please interrupt if a metric doesn't match your view.'
Opportunity Snapshot (host + CSM): 'Two quick stories: ops saved X hours, product feature Y drove Z% engagement. These map to your stated success metrics because...'
Decision Canvas (facilitator): 'We'll walk the canvas column by column. For each item, I need a short callout and whether you rate impact/effort as High/Med/Low.'

Renewal Ask (host): 'We propose these two options. Option 1 (baseline): renew at current scope. Option 2 (accelerated): +additional seats/data pipeline with a 6-month success milestone. Which aligns with your priorities today?'
Close (host): 'We have the decision recorded: [X]. Next steps are assigned. We'll follow up with the signed commitment doc and a 14-day onboarding milestone plan.'
prep_checklist: Pre-read (send 48–72 hours before): 1-page signals + one-line recommended ask + decision canvas template
Metrics pack: 2–3 charts (MAU/DAU for product flows that matter, error/latency incidents, cost per inference trend)
Stakeholder map: list of attendees, decision authority, procurement contact, legal contact
Customized decision canvas: pre-fill known facts (ARR, last quarter adoption, active projects) so the meeting focuses on tradeoffs not data gathering
Renewal scenarios draft: baseline and accelerated with delta in ARR and 3-month milestones
Doc access & permissions checked: ensure customer attendees can view collaboration doc and the facilitator can edit
Note taker assigned and shared doc template allocated
Ops check: have SRE/solutions contact on standby for any technical clarifications
Logistics: calendar link, dial-in, timezone check, allow +5 minutes buffer for late arrivals
decision_canvas_template: Canvas instructions: facilitator populates rows; ask stakeholders to rate impact/effort/risk as High/Med/Low and add 1-sentence rationale

Rows: 'Opportunity/Area', 'Success metric (S.M.A.R.T.)', 'Current baseline', 'Expected delta with proposed work', 'Approx effort (weeks/engineer)', 'Cost delta (ARR or one-time)', 'Critical dependencies', 'Top risks and mitigations', 'Recommended path (A/B/Defer)', 'Owner for first milestone'
Tip: limit to 2 canvas items per meeting to ensure depth; use parking lot for others

post_meeting_playbook: Within 24h: Send decision confirmation email with one-paragraph rationale and attached amendment or renewal options
Within 3 days: Sales/CS/Legal sync to finalize drafting of amendment or PO requirements
Within 7 days: Deliver first milestone plan and schedule kickoff if accelerated path chosen
If no decision: schedule 30-minute follow-up focused only on outstanding blockers and procurement readiness
notes_to_self: This compact kit is built for speed. If customer signals high strategic intent, escalate to extended 90–120m format that includes technical working session and service-level commitments. Save a copy of the filled decision canvas to the account folder (cs/accounts/<account>/decision-canvas).
